Twenty-eight meetings in two parts: **Foundations** builds the toolkit on
tabular data — by hand through session 7, AI from session 8 — and
**Applications** takes one unconventional data family per session through the
same pipeline. Homework posts Thursday after class and is due the following
Thursday at 8:40 am; the [syllabus](syllabus.qmd) has the policies.
